_about: Severe weather on the Chicago lakefront, Oct 2022 - Oct 2026: the periods the History snapshot workflow builds (label -> window) and what the page says about each. Windows are when the weather peaked at the lakefront (UTC). Sources: NWS Chicago event summaries (weather.gov/lot), NDBC CHII2 (Harrison-Dever Crib) and 45174 (Wilmette) archives, GLERL ice, IEM ASOS. fdd: freezing degree-days (deg C days) of the cold spell up to the event, rough, for the ice's thickness and kind.

events.label: blizzard-2022-12-22
events.title: Dec 22 2022 blizzard: the front
events.headline: Pre-Christmas bomb cyclone: the arctic front crossed the city (27 to 9 F in four hours) under the heaviest snow

events.label: blizzard-2022-12-23
events.title: Dec 23 2022 blizzard winds
events.headline: Blizzard conditions in blowing snow: Harrison-Dever Crib 56 mph, Montrose Beach light 56 mph, -8 F, wind chill -37 (KLOT was down that afternoon: Milwaukee's radar)

events.label: flood-2023-07-02
events.title: Jul 2 2023 flood
events.headline: Training storms: Lincoln Park 7.4-7.9 in, Garfield Park 8.1 in, 1.6 in in one hour at Midway; 70,000 flooded basements

events.label: tornado-2023-07-12
events.title: Jul 12 2023 O'Hare tornadoes
events.headline: 13 tornadoes in NE Illinois, EF-0s through O'Hare and Park Ridge; the weakening line reached the lakefront about 7:30 PM

events.label: gale-2023-10-14
events.title: Oct 14 2023 northeast gale
events.headline: The biggest waves of 2023: Wilmette buoy 12.8 ft significant height, crib 49 mph NE; 20 ft breakers at 31st and 63rd St

events.label: gale-2024-01-12
events.title: Jan 12 2024 snow and east gale
events.headline: The strongest onshore gale of the period: crib 62 mph east, O'Hare 55 mph, 6.7 in of snow in fog and quarter-mile visibility

events.label: arctic-2024-01-14
events.title: Jan 14 2024 arctic blast
events.headline: -12 F at the Museum Campus, wind chill -37, lake-effect streamers off a northwest wind; nearshore ice Jan 17-23 (lake max 18%)

events.label: tornado-2024-07-14
events.title: Jul 14 2024 night tornadoes
events.headline: Two EF-0 tornadoes ran off the South Side onto the lake (Kenwood, Jackson Park); crib 56 mph

events.label: derecho-2024-07-15
events.title: Jul 15 2024 derecho
events.headline: A record 32 tornadoes in the Chicago forecast area, four in the city (EF-1s on the West Side and Chicago Lawn); crib 59 mph

events.label: arctic-2025-01-21
events.title: Jan 21 2025 arctic blast
events.headline: -8 F at O'Hare, wind chill -29; shelf ice at Montrose, ice ribbons along the shore on Landsat Jan 24; lake ice peaked at 34% Feb 21

events.label: hail-2025-05-15
events.title: May 15 2025 hail and wind
events.headline: Crib 79 mph, inch hail in Uptown, trees down in Edgewater and Andersonville; 3 in hail in the suburbs

events.label: dust-2025-05-16
events.title: May 16 2025 dust storm
events.headline: The first dust storm warning for the city: crib 78 mph outflow, near-zero visibility in the South Loop

events.label: flood-2025-07-08
events.title: Jul 8 2025 flash flood
events.headline: One stationary storm: 5.1 in in 90 minutes at Garfield Park, 3.8 in in the Loop, water rescues on the West Side

events.label: lakeeffect-2025-11-10
events.title: Nov 10 2025 lake-effect thundersnow
events.headline: Two lake-effect bands with a gap over downtown: West Ridge 5.7 in, Evanston 5.2 in, thundersnow by the lake before dawn

events.label: winterstorm-2025-11-29
events.title: Nov 29 2025 record November snow
events.headline: 8.4 in at O'Hare, the snowiest November day on record; freezing fog and quarter-mile visibility, 480 crashes

events.label: arctic-2026-01-23
events.title: Jan 23 2026 arctic blast
events.headline: -11 F at O'Hare, wind chill -36; pancake and shelf ice at Ohio St Beach Jan 24-26; Lake Michigan 37% ice Jan 31, the most of these four winters

events.label: lakesnow-2026-01-25
events.title: Jan 25 2026 lake-enhanced snow
events.headline: A band hugging the shore: Loop 10.5 in, Lincoln Park 8.8 in against 4.4 in at O'Hare

events.label: squall-2026-04-02
events.title: Apr 2 2026 squall line
events.headline: Midway 70 mph, Logan Square 64 mph, Harrison-Dever Crib 72 mph as the line crossed the lakefront

events.label: derecho-2026-06-10
events.title: Jun 10 2026 derecho
events.headline: Crib 85 mph, Loop high-rise windows blown out, 73-78 mph Hyde Park to Lakeview, tree damage at Montrose Harbor

events.label: tornado-2026-06-11
events.title: Jun 11 2026 tornado outbreak
events.headline: Hickory Hills to Garfield Ridge EF-2 (120 mph, 8 mi), two EF-3s in the region; the storms crossed the lakefront around 9 PM

events.label: severe-2026-07-27
events.title: Jul 27 2026 severe storms and meteotsunami
events.headline: Boats flipped at the Evanston lakefront, crib 74 mph, 1.25 in hail at Northerly Island, seven tornadoes; a 2.7 ft seiche at the Chicago Lock that evening

events.label: derecho-2026-08-11
events.title: Aug 11 2026 derecho
events.headline: A morning derecho: crib 60 mph then silent, eight tornadoes (Monee to Crown Point EF-2), a lakeshore flood warning for the seiche

events.label: gale-2026-10-16
events.title: Oct 16 2026 north gale
events.headline: Gale warning: crib 47 mph N, Wilmette buoy gusting 54 mph and 10 ft seas by midnight, 20 ft at Michigan City
